theme.mood: Bright, fresh, optimistic, earthy, high-yielding agricultural focus
theme.primary_palette: White, Harvest Yellow (#C59B27 / #EAB308), Lush Crop Green (#0A2F24 / #15803D)

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond / Tiro Devanagari Marathi / Display Serif

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-emerald-950

hero_primary.description: Indian farmer applying fertilizer in a lush green field with visible soil and thriving crops, bright optimistic daylight

hero_backup.description: Happy farmer broadcasting nutrition/fertilizer across crop rows showing green foliage and rich soil

visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: Subtle SVG turbulence grain for organic tactile feeling
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle leaf sway, granule float, marquee drift for certified products
visual_enhancers.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure header navigation is visible on desktop with high contrast backdrop.
Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Use primary image URL hero_fertilizer_farmer in the hero section.
Ensure image container maintains landscape aspect ratio with clear text overlay contrast.
